mechanism: Electric-load growth, data-centre construction, utility capital expenditure, and grid constraints increase demand for Atkore electrical raceway, conduit, and cable-management products; shareholder benefit depends on pricing catching input costs and volume converting to free cash flow.
catalyst: Electrical volume remains positive while pricing catches input inflation, segment margin recovers, and operating cash flow turns sustainably positive.
invalidation: Electrical demand fails to produce segment volume or input costs, competition, project delays, and working capital prevent adequate margin and free-cash-flow conversion.

mechanism: A recovery in residential solar financing, installer health, channel inventory, and storage adoption directly raises demand for Enphase microinverters, batteries, gateways, and energy-management software; shareholder benefit depends on margin, cash, warranty, tariff, and policy quality.
catalyst: US sell-through stabilises without inventory growth, battery shipments recover, tariff-adjusted margin holds, and normalised free cash flow remains positive.
invalidation: Financing and lost incentives keep demand structurally lower, inventory requires discounting, safe-harbour commitments do not become installations, or tariffs, warranties, and purchase obligations impair returns and cash.

mechanism: Load growth, renewable penetration, grid congestion, and reliability needs increase demand for Fluence storage systems, services, and optimization software; shareholder benefit depends on project margin, working-capital, warranty, and financing conversion.
catalyst: Backlog converts at stable or rising normalized gross margin, adjusted EBITDA guidance is delivered, and operating cash flow turns sustainably positive.
invalidation: Storage deployment or backlog weakens, project costs and competition compress margins, working capital remains structurally negative, warranties or trade rules raise costs, or financing dilutes returns.
